target.title: improve(android): inspect configured model providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android users could see broad provider readiness summaries in Settings > Providers & Models, but the screen did not clearly show the provider-authored model IDs that come from `models.providers.*.models`. That made it hard to distinguish source-configured model rows from runtime/default catalog expansion or agent allowlists.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a source-aware provider model inspection path for the Android app. The screen now loads a provider-configured model view, expands each provider to show model IDs, and displays readiness/availability from Gateway.

The review surfaced a source-of-truth risk: the existing `models.list` `configured` view can be affected by `agents.defaults.models` allowlists, while the source of provider-authored rows is `models.providers.*.models`. This update fixes that by adding a source-aware `models.list` view, `provider-config`, and making Android Settings > Providers & Models use that view. The normal picker-style `configured` view keeps its existing allowlist behavior.

Follow-up review also surfaced an Android state-sharing issue: the shared Android `modelCatalog` state was being reused by both normal picker/health consumers and the Providers & Models settings screen. This update splits the Android state so:

- `modelCatalog` remains the normal configured picker/catalog view.
- `providerModelCatalog` is dedicated to Settings > Providers & Models and uses `view: "provider-config"`.

That keeps the provider-model inspection source of truth aligned without changing unrelated Android model consumers.

## User Impact

Android users can now:

- View provider-configured model providers and model IDs under each provider.
- Refresh provider/model availability from Gateway.
- See provider-authored model rows separately from allowlist-only/default runtime expansion.

This PR does not add Android add/remove/configure controls; the current Android surface is a read-only provider-config inspection and refresh path.

## Evidence

Code/test coverage added:

- Android request-scope coverage in `ProviderModelCatalogRequestTest` proving the Providers & Models refresh path requests `models.list` with `view: "provider-config"`.
- Android UI/state coverage in `ProviderModelStatusTest` for provider model rows and availability status rendering.
- Gateway model-list coverage proving `models.list` `provider-config` returns provider-authored rows even when `agents.defaults.models` allowlists exist, and does not show allowlist-only models.
- Protocol validation coverage for `models.list` `view: "provider-config"`.
- Updated native Android i18n source inventory for the new strings.
- Updated gateway/model docs to document `configured` vs `provider-config` semantics.

Current PR head:

- `9ada99f68ecf72ccb3791499c5098a770b3dd4c7`

GitHub checks on the current PR head:

- Upstream PR checks are passing/skipped as applicable, including `Real behavior proof`, dependency guard, security-sensitive guard, label, and dispatch automation.
- No local Android build/test/emulator evidence is used as final evidence for this update.

## Real behavior proof

Real Android UI/media proof was captured from `snowzlmbot/openclaw` GitHub Actions, not from a local emulator and not from source/static screenshots.

- Proof workflow run: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29017302051
- Source PR head built by proof workflow: `9ada99f68ecf72ccb3791499c5098a770b3dd4c7`
- Artifact: `pr-101912-real-android-models-media-proof-9ada99f68ecf72ccb3791499c5098a770b3dd4c7`
- Artifact id: `8198400467`
- Artifact size: ~2.2 MB
- Artifact expires: 2026-08-08
- Artifact contents: real emulator PNG screenshots, UIAutomator XML dumps, ADB screenrecord MP4, Android logcat, proof gateway request log, manifest, and proof summary.

What the media proof demonstrates:

1. The workflow checks out `android-models-management-20260708` at `9ada99f68ecf72ccb3791499c5098a770b3dd4c7` and builds the debug APK in GitHub Actions.
2. GitHub Actions starts an Android emulator and installs the APK.
3. The app connects through its real Android `GatewaySession` WebSocket path to a local proof gateway.
4. The real UI opens Settings > Providers & Models.
5. The screen displays provider-configured model IDs from a live `models.list` request with `view: "provider-config"`.
6. The screen displays visible availability state for provider-configured model rows.
7. Tapping Refresh reloads the provider-configured model list through the same Android GatewaySession path.

The downloaded proof artifact was inspected before updating this PR. Its gateway request log contains `models.list` with `provider-config`, `models.authStatus`, and normal configured catalog requests; its UI XML/screenshots show the Providers & Models screen, `proof-model-alpha`, `proof-remove-me`, and visible `Available` states before and after refresh.

Not run locally:

- Android Gradle build/ktlint/test suites were not used as final local evidence; Android APK build and media capture were performed by GitHub Actions above.

## Risk and rollback

- Risk is limited to model-list source selection and Android Settings > Providers & Models presentation/state wiring.
- The normal `configured` model picker/catalog view keeps its existing allowlist behavior.
- Rollback is straightforward: revert this PR to restore the previous Android Providers & Models behavior and remove the `provider-config` model-list view.
